stages.title: Inventory and reproducible qualification setup
tasks: Record exact Googlebook SKU/build/API/ABI, WebView, input devices, display scaling, network, and available decoders.
Map each named host to its installed OS/build/GPU/driver/user session and Linux compositor; list actual boards/probes and reset identities.
Pair ADB through the documented model/port path; capture sanitized baseline diagnostics and a run manifest.
Select one primary host/project/probe and define a lab-side fallback topology before multiplying combinations.
deliverables: Completed private inventory and sanitized public matrix
Qualification run template populated with versions/topology
exitCriteria: ADB can install/run a minimal development build on the target, or an exact blocker is documented.
No host OS, decoder, peripheral, or compositor support is inferred from model name.

stages.title: Platform API, lifecycle, and capability probes
tasks: Inspect the API tracker and pin candidate SDK/AndroidX versions for windows, caption bounds, input, files, and foreground-service experiments.
Build minimal resize/multi-instance/caption/focus probes with runtime guards and record experimental annotations.
Classify SSH, transfers, USB, and streaming lifecycle strategies independently; force relevant timeout/process-recreation cases.
Investigate supported local Linux VM attach/control interfaces; record absence or roadmap status without private-API assumptions.
deliverables: Operation-specific lifecycle decision note and VM boundary record
exitCriteria: Every proposed API use has a version guard or fallback.
System IME/launcher and Linux roadmap limits are reflected in release scope.

stages.title: SSH engine and terminal renderer qualification
tasks: Compare maintained JVM/native SSH candidates for Android ABI, algorithms/trust, PTY/SFTP/jumps/forwards, X11 channel/cookie hooks, footprint, license and update ownership.
Embed a pinned local xterm.js experiment with a narrow native boundary and compare a native renderer if needed.
Run exact-byte paste, CJK IME/preedit, wide-cell/emoji, TUI, selection, resize and sustained-output cases with physical desktop inputs.
Record CPU/memory/input latency and accessible terminal behavior; select the engine/renderer or a bounded remediation experiment.
deliverables: Renderer/SSH ADR with versions and rejected alternatives
Input/TUI fixture results and local-renderer boundary probe
exitCriteria: First-trust/changed-key behavior and input correctness pass on actual hardware.
Unresolved accessibility/IME failures block renderer adoption, not basic project planning.

stages.title: Streaming, RDP/VNC, physical input and decoder qualification
tasks: Pin Sunshine/Moonlight and prove external handoff; select buildable RDP/VNC engine candidates and record actual server/encoding/security negotiation.
Exercise trackpad and external mouse in real CAD and text/desktop workloads; verify focus-loss release and native IME/keyboard paths.
Enumerate codecs and optional API-30 low-latency support; measure native decode/pacing/text quality, power and input-to-photon baseline.
Test primary host sessions, lock/headless/permissions, RDP certificate/NLA requirements and protected VNC routes; record unsupported cases and dependencies.
deliverables: Pinned stream/RDP/VNC engine and server feasibility matrix
Native decoder/input baseline, measured boundaries and external handoff contract
exitCriteria: The primary stream workflow passes or has an explicit tested fallback; RDP and VNC each have a build/integration path and blocker list.
No inference of latency, RemoteApp, server security or trackpad support from a package name; unqualified combinations remain excluded.

stages.title: USB provider and real programming workflow
tasks: Verify Android provider/workstation consumer licensing, permission ownership and consumer-side API on the actual USB topology.
Program/verify the actual board/probe with runtime/bootloader/DFU/composite identities recorded.
Probe hotplug, replug, permission denial, auto-use toggle/state semantics, consumer restart, contention and protected ownership reconciliation in a controlled lab.
If Android forwarding fails, qualify a lab-side provider/hardware server and report that the local Googlebook plug-and-play requirement remains unmet.
deliverables: Probe-specific flash/verify evidence, enrollment identity set and permission map
Backend control/auto-use decision and tested fallback topology
exitCriteria: The actual target programs/verifies; serial-only success does not certify JTAG/DFU.
Ownership recovery is established without automatic flash retry or timer-based reassignment.

stages.title: X11 forwarding and native application-window feasibility
tasks: Prove ordinary SSH x11-req/cookie substitution with remote xauth and two isolated host contexts.
Build a maintained Android X server candidate and prototype top-level, transient-dialog and popup mapping to Googlebook native windows without root/private APIs.
Test physical keyboard/IME, focus, caption/resize/display scaling, clipboard boundaries and disconnect/process-death semantics.
Record exact engine/license/build/backend and broker cost; reject a single X desktop as completion of the separate-window requirement.
deliverables: X11 engine/window-broker feasibility ADR and prototype evidence
Per-application window support/failure matrix and re-estimate
exitCriteria: Two remote apps have independent native desktop windows and correct owned dialogs, or the required capability is explicitly blocked with a scope proposal.
Cookie/trust context isolation and actual GUI connection lifetime are demonstrated; no root/shared-signing/private VM dependency.

stages.title: Network measurements and first system decision gate
tasks: Measure direct/relay routing for stream/RDP/VNC/X11/files and reverse USB with actual firewall/tailnet policies.
Record independent payload/wire counters plus repeatable Moonlight/Parsec comparisons where supported; label GeForce NOW contextual.
Run controlled latency/jitter/loss/route/outage profiles outside protected programming and measure adaptation/recovery/input integrity.
Ratify or revise desktop budgets and full workflow estimates; publish explicit blockers, tested fallbacks and support exclusions.
deliverables: Primary topology latency/pacing/traffic/recovery baseline with raw evidence
P0 go/adjust decision for all revised requirements and desktop-only scope
exitCriteria: Each critical input/probe/backend risk has evidence or an accepted qualified fallback.
Console can progress independently even while a Desktop hardware branch remains unresolved.

stages.title: Native app targets and shared-module build foundation
tasks: Establish two independently installable signed development APK targets, shared source boundaries and reproducible Android/NDK toolchains selected from P0.
Apply Rule 0: desktop/laptop Googlebook target, separate package IDs/app data, no phone/tablet UI workstream; document manifest/ABI/minSdk/targetSdk and channel assumptions.
Build native shells with per-window context and real lifecycle state; keep baseline SSH/RDP/VNC independent of the custom host agent.
Document APK installation versus AAB publishing and verify package install/update/uninstall using authorized Android tooling.
deliverables: Two installable debug APKs and toolchain lock record
Module graph and minimal launch smoke evidence
exitCriteria: Each app launches with the other app absent.
No source module depends on the other app process or UI.

stages.title: Cloudy design system and native shell
tasks: Implement canonical Cloudy tokens and native desktop controls with user font scaling, two themes, density and system caption bounds.
Prototype resizable terminal+SFTP arrangements, X11 app/dialog windows, backend profile/trust screens, USB enrollment and diagnostics.
Qualify keyboard navigation, shortcut discovery, right-click/hover/cursors, range selection, pointer/touch access and focus ownership on Googlebook.
Run narrow tiled/short windows, multi-instance and display-scale changes; preserve desktop workflows without adding phone/tablet navigation.
deliverables: Native desktop component catalog and S01–S17 interaction review
Rule 0 and applicable official desktop-quality evidence ledger
exitCriteria: No system control overlap, focus trap, unreadable semantic pair, or unreachable scaled action.
Visual choices preserve terminal/file/media working area and clear host context.

stages.title: Identity, typed contracts, and lifecycle persistence
tasks: Implement per-app protected credential handles, known-host trust storage, enrollment cancellation, and revocation.
Implement signature-protected explicit IPC with bounded versioned resource envelopes, caller validation, expiration, and receiver-side resource resolution.
Add persisted session/layout metadata, transfer journals, typed errors, and bounded redacted diagnostics.
Implement the qualified foreground/background strategy, timeout handlers, focus-loss cleanup, and reconnect metadata.
Define X11 broker/SSH/window lifetimes, URI staging grants, per-backend client ownership and USB enrollment restoration without a shared immortal daemon.
exitCriteria: No exported secret/raw command through handoff, logs, or renderer messages.
Process recreation restores metadata without replaying a side effect.

stages.title: CI, dependency decision, and foundation gate
tasks: Add real Android build/lint/unit/instrumentation checks and contract fixture validation; retain documentation checks.
Record dependency versions/licenses/update owners and choose the project distribution/license direction before embedding upstream implementations.
Exercise mismatched app/protocol versions, missing recipient, unavailable permissions, and independent install/uninstall.
Publish the P1 evidence bundle and refine remaining stage estimates using actual implementation results.
Resolve X server, FreeRDP, VNC engine and transitive native codec/license/security/build obligations before P2/P3 embedding; P5 stream review does not substitute for this gate.
deliverables: Reproducible CI artifacts and dependency register
Foundation gate record with unresolved issues
exitCriteria: Both apps install independently and communicate only through validated resource contracts.
CI output is labeled separately from physical-device evidence.

stages.title: Trusted SSH connectivity, authentication, and jumps
tasks: Implement profiles and engine adapters for connect/cancel, host trust, authentication, and typed failures.
Add key/password/keyboard-interactive methods supported by the selected engine and keep prompts in native UI.
Implement jump chains with trust at every hop and clean channel shutdown.
Exercise key change, wrong credentials, offline DNS/route, authentication cancel, and per-host revocation.
exitCriteria: A plain SSH server works without Desktop or the custom host agent.
Changed keys block before secrets are sent and errors identify the failing layer.

stages.title: Interactive terminal correctness and bounded data path
tasks: Connect PTY bytes/resize to the selected renderer with bounded queues/backpressure off the UI thread.
Implement negotiated terminal features, exact paste/composition, selection, clipboard policy, and external link opening.
Exercise editors, agent menus/diffs, alternate screen, mouse reporting, Unicode widths, and long prompts.
Measure local input/render latency, sustained output, scrollback bounds, and accessible terminal behavior.
deliverables: Working PTY surface and supported-feature declaration
exitCriteria: No duplicate/lost paste or committed IME text and no stuck modifiers.
Supported output rate is sustained without silent loss or unbounded growth.

stages.title: Tabs, panes, windows, search, and durable sessions
tasks: Implement split trees, keyboard focus, tab naming/close semantics, pane zoom, and local scrollback search.
Persist layouts per window profile and support explicit independent tasks/windows with safe resize behavior.
Attach to configured tmux sessions on supported environments; label ordinary Windows sessions non-persistent.
Recover from network loss/process eviction/host reboot with actual session identity and no input/command replay.
exitCriteria: Session state distinguishes disconnect, detach, ended process, and unknown.
A saved layout that no longer fits keeps sessions reachable without terminating them.

stages.title: SFTP attachments and local browser forwards
tasks: Add picker/drop/pasted-image staging with destination confirmation and hash/size validation.
Insert environment-correct remote paths only after completion; preserve failed jobs and local text.
Implement explicit loopback forwards, collisions, lifetime/close controls, and external browser previews.
Exercise URI permission revoke, source change, interrupted upload, Windows/WSL quoting, and callback timeout.
exitCriteria: No half-uploaded attachment reference or implicit shell submission.
Forwarded content never loads inside the privileged renderer.

stages.title: SSH X11 forwarding and separate native app windows
tasks: Integrate the qualified X server and native window broker with SSH X11 request/channel/cookie handling and per-trust-context display isolation.
Map top-level windows, transient/modal dialogs, popups, close requests and host labels to native Googlebook windows with accurate input/IME/scale.
Add per-session graphical-window list, restricted/trusted mode policy, prerequisites and layer-specific diagnostics.
Exercise multiple hosts/apps, reconnect, timeout, activity/process recreation and GUI termination without command replay or false tmux durability.
deliverables: Independent Console X11 app-window workflow and bounded native bridge
exitCriteria: Required separate remote app windows and owned dialogs pass on Googlebook without Desktop or custom host agent.
Actual X server/SSH versions, restrictions and GUI durability limits are published; a single full X desktop cannot pass this gate.

stages.title: Session-linked SFTP pane and bidirectional drag-and-drop
tasks: Build adjacent session-bound SFTP browsing/actions, pinned/follow-active context, breadcrumbs, search and transfer drawer using shared file/transfer models.
Implement URI-grant-aware uploads, downloads, directory jobs, staged exports to other apps and terminal path insertion after verified commit.
Add explicit manual directory selection and optional validated shell integration; do not scrape prompts or infer shell CWD from SFTP.
Qualify staged remote edits/conflicts, late-reading receivers, changed/revoked sources, process death and tab/host switch during transfer.
deliverables: Console SFTP pane, shared transfer journal and staging content-provider contract
Incoming/outgoing drop and remote-edit integrity evidence
exitCriteria: Browse/upload/download/edit and both Android drop directions pass with Desktop absent, correct captured host/path, and no auto-submit.
Unsupported receivers/server features show a tested Save/Share or manual path fallback; source changes preserve conflict copies.

stages.title: Agent workflows, profile import, and Console daily-use gate
tasks: Qualify selected current agent CLIs as ordinary PTY applications with versions/authentication recorded; keep their credentials on the host.
Add optional local composer, discoverable newline behavior, and configurable terminal bell/task alerts without screen-scraped approval logic.
Add a previewed non-secret profile import with an explicit supported SSH-config subset.
Run a full coding day with Desktop/custom host agent absent, including separate X11 apps, session-linked SFTP upload/download/edit/drop, terminal/TUI and recovery.
deliverables: R1 Console candidate and CLI compatibility matrix
exitCriteria: The full revised Console workflow passes including X11 windows and integrated SFTP; an earlier SSH-only build is labeled a partial milestone.
No command/approval replay, hidden dependency on Desktop/host agent or unsupported GUI durability claim.

stages.title: Desktop hosts, workspaces, and capability presentation
tasks: Implement manual host/workspace profiles with explicit environment/project roots and non-secret import.
Present installed/paired/reachable/permission-required/unknown states without conflation.
Add desktop/backend/display/input preference records without claiming an active session.
Map S06/S09 navigation and details to typed models with last-observed timestamps.
exitCriteria: Host, environment, project, and backend identities remain explicit.
Missing agent/backend produces a supported setup path rather than a false connected state.

stages.title: External desktop handoff and backend setup
tasks: Implement only the supported launch/profile route proved in P0; validate target package/backend version.
Provide clear external transition, pairing/setup instructions, and manual-launch fallback when control is unavailable.
Persist per-host profile preferences and visible return-to-workspace actions.
Test unavailable client, unavailable host, permission denial, cancellation, and stream/client exit.
exitCriteria: Primary visual application is reachable with documented handoff behavior.
No unsupported upstream control API is invented or hidden behind a fake live view.

stages.title: File browser, transfer journal, and conflict-safe writes
tasks: Implement distinct local/SFTP/system-Drive-provider roots with supported-operation metadata.
Build list/table, selection, details, staged copy, journal, resumable transfer, and commit states.
Bind resume to source version, validate destination, preserve conflict copies, and bound caches.
Exercise huge directories, symlinks, case/reserved names, permission failures, source change, cancellation, and interrupted commit.
Reuse the Console-qualified file/transfer components with independent Desktop credentials/jobs; distinguish cross-root orchestration from session-level file context.
deliverables: Full file/transfer workflow with state journal
exitCriteria: No silent overwrite or false remote-commit success.
Unsupported backend semantics are visible and do not silently fall back to destructive behavior.

stages.title: USB ownership and protected operation orchestration
tasks: Wrap the qualified provider/consumer control or manual workflow with version-aware capability discovery.
Implement backend-confirmed ownership states, explicit attach/release, reset identity set, and protection UI.
Reconcile after transport loss, app restart, consumer failure, and conflicting host requests.
Expose logs/errors and a deliberate recovery path; never automatically retry programming or assign an unknown device.
deliverables: Device ownership view and reconciliation adapter
exitCriteria: Only a confirmed released device can be reassigned.
The primary actual probe passes the integrated program/verify journey.

stages.title: Enrolled USB plug-and-play and reenumeration recovery
tasks: Implement enrollment for provider/device/serial-or-port identity, approved reset aliases, one consumer and visible reversible auto-attach policy.
Observe provider attach/detach and permission status; reconcile consumer state before auto-attaching only known idle devices to the enrolled host.
Handle toggle-only backend controls, duplicate events, ambiguous timeout, consumer restart and approved same-owner reenumeration without blind retry.
Run at least 30 normal hotplug cycles plus permission, contention, loss and protected-operation failures with exact tool/firmware identities.
deliverables: USB enrollment and quiet plug/replug workflow
exitCriteria: Enrolled normal hotplug reaches confirmed ready without repeated Cloudy dialogs where platform grants permit; first-use/OS prompts remain explicit.
Unknown/protected/competing ownership never causes reassignment or flash replay; published support is device/topology-specific.

stages.title: Native integrated RDP client
tasks: Embed the qualified maintained RDP engine behind the native surface/input interface with explicit profile, server identity and credential handling.
Support required certificate/NLA authentication, desktop rendering, keyboard/IME, pointer/wheel, scaling/resize, clipboard policy and capture release.
Expose negotiated transport/graphics/capabilities and connection/session recovery; qualify UDP/TCP conditions and primary Windows/compatible server behavior.
Record optional RemoteApp/gateway/redirection support separately; test with Console and the custom host agent absent.
exitCriteria: A native RDP session passes identity/auth/input/render/recovery cases on the primary supported server; external launch alone is insufficient.
No silent security downgrade, protocol switch, duplicated input or unsupported session/RemoteApp claim.

stages.title: Native integrated VNC client
tasks: Embed the license/security-approved RFB client behind the native desktop interface and add explicit encoding/security/server profiles.
Support framebuffer/cursor/input, resize if negotiated, clipboard policy and a verified encrypted or authenticated-tunnel route.
Bound update/decode memory without discarding dependent protocol state; expose actual encoding/security and server extension limits.
Qualify primary VNC servers, malformed/unsupported updates, network recovery and file handoff through independent SFTP where available.
exitCriteria: Native VNC desktop/input/recovery works with Console/custom host agent absent on the supported server matrix; external viewer launch alone is insufficient.
No plaintext/None security downgrade, state-corrupting update drops, or assumed universal file-transfer extension.

stages.title: Console/Desktop vertical slice and companion gate
tasks: Connect/build in Console, upload an artifact, open the same registered workspace in Desktop, and start visual work.
Program/verify the attached target, inspect output, and preserve exact host/project/device context.
Interrupt/restore connectivity without replaying commands or losing ownership accounting.
Export a measured usage report and publish R2 limitations/dependency installations.
Run native RDP and VNC independently, then the enrolled USB plug/build/program/inspect path; document capability differences and partial milestones.
exitCriteria: R2 includes working native RDP/VNC, files and enrolled USB plug-and-play on qualified combinations plus honest high-performance stream handoff.
No app borrows another app credential/process; protected ownership and file/source context remain correct across handoff.

stages.title: Host agent pairing, capabilities, jobs, and resumable events
tasks: Implement separately versioned host core with authenticated pairing, revocation, scopes, and capability negotiation.
Add request IDs/expiration/idempotency policy, registered roots, managed jobs, and bounded diagnostics.
Implement stream/boot identities, sequence/cursors, retention, gap snapshots, and event persistence.
Test unauthorized/stale requests, repeated IDs, disconnects, restart, missing backend, and version skew.
deliverables: Optional host-core service and protocol implementation
exitCriteria: Ordinary Console SSH still works without the agent.
A repeated request or event cannot silently repeat a side effect.

stages.title: Windows user-session notification adapter
tasks: Validate packaging/capability and user-consent requirements for UserNotificationListener.
Implement source/text/icon/dismissal capabilities that are actually supported, with bounded icon handling.
Handle access denial/revocation, session switching, host restart, and background synchronization explicitly.
Test Android permission/channel denial and keep the in-app activity path functional.
exitCriteria: Correct host/source attribution and no stale-action promises.
Revoked access is distinct from an empty healthy inbox.

stages.title: Linux and macOS scoped event adapters
tasks: Evaluate supported Linux desktop notification integration against the actual daemon/compositor.
Implement macOS own-job/app-specific events and permission-aware status; keep arbitrary notification capture uncommitted.
Separate user-session helper lifecycle from the background host core.
Qualify source attribution, capability absence, permission changes, lock/logout/restart, and adapter errors.
deliverables: Per-OS adapter capabilities and supported limitations
exitCriteria: No universal notification observer claim without a supported interface.
Own-job events remain useful when system-wide forwarding is unavailable.

stages.title: Agent hooks, event deduplication, and R3 gate
tasks: Add version-pinned supported hooks for selected managed jobs/agent tools; keep generic PTY operation independent.
Bind running/waiting/completed/failed states to current job/request/session identities.
Deduplicate events across both apps, suppress loops, respect expiry, and avoid offline reconnect alert storms.
Run event retention/offline/gap/permission scenarios and publish exact per-OS fidelity.
exitCriteria: No screen-text inference or replayed approval operation.
Expired history remains history rather than newly actionable notifications.

stages.title: Integrated streaming license and maintenance decision
tasks: Review actual upstream license/source obligations and choose external-only or maintained native integration.
Assess fork/update ownership, backend/client version compatibility, packaging, decoder/input surfaces, and reproducible builds.
Confirm that R2 handoff limitations justify the added integration scope.
If external-only is selected, replace P5-S2 implementation with qualified external-flow polish and re-estimate the phase.
Treat native high-performance integration as the full-scope target; an external-only decision must explicitly revise user-visible scope, stage estimates and unresolved requirements.
exitCriteria: No integrated streaming code is shipped before the distribution model is resolved.
Scope/effort is revised if the external-only branch is selected.

stages.title: Native high-performance stream and latency/stability qualification
tasks: Integrate the approved maintained native stream engine with direct media/input, native Surface and measured decoder/profile selection.
Minimize copies/queue age, use supported low-latency decoder modes, and implement backend-supported adaptation with stable audio/video pacing.
Qualify CAD/keyboard/trackpad/mouse, display/scaling/capture release, permissions/session and thermal 8-hour behavior.
Compare input-to-photon and quality against qualified standalone Moonlight and Parsec where supported; run impaired links and recovery without false parity claims.
deliverables: Native high-performance Desktop stream path and diagnostics
Matched comparison/pacing/power/stability results with explicit target decisions
exitCriteria: Native media/input path and required real CAD work pass; no video through general UI bridges.
P0-ratified latency/quality/stability budgets have measured outcomes and no unresolved input/trust/data-integrity blocker; any scope change is explicit.

stages.title: DocumentsProvider and cached editing
tasks: Expose selected remote roots with stable document IDs, supported flags, explicit grants, and bounded cache.
Implement local staging, source identity/version checks, commit acknowledgements, offline queued edits, and conflict copies.
Test provider consumers, random/sequential access needs, canceled writes, revoked URI access, and process death.
Document backend semantic limits and cleanup/pinning/eviction settings.
exitCriteria: No remote file is labeled committed until the backend confirms publication.
Concurrent/offline edits preserve data and explicit conflict choices.

stages.title: Metered policy, accounting, and integrated desktop gate
tasks: Add policy for hidden streams, thumbnails, prefetch, bitrate selection, and explicit large-transfer choices.
Label counters by interval/endpoint/direction/payload-or-wire/estimate and path-observability limits.
Compare app/stream counters with OS/router measurements without double-counting endpoint copies.
Run protected USB operations while changing bulk-transfer priorities and budget thresholds.
Measure file/USB contention and adaptive stream behavior with hysteresis; preserve protocol state and protected operations while prioritizing interactive work.
deliverables: R4 integrated desktop candidate and measured usage report
exitCriteria: Counter scope is understandable and measured values align within declared boundaries.
Budget policy never silently interrupts protected programming or fabricates path telemetry.

stages.title: Failure injection, long sessions, and power transitions
tasks: Exercise client eviction, host restart, network switch, route loss, timeout, permission revoke, sleep/resume, and lid/display changes.
Run eight-hour terminal/stream/transfer workloads with memory/cache bounds and battery/thermal observations.
Verify independent app operation, no command/approval/flash replay, and authoritative USB/file reconciliation.
Fix critical defects and narrow support claims where reliable behavior is not established.
Repeat required X11 window, SFTP grant/export/edit, RDP/VNC session and USB enrolled hotplug failure cases across suspend/resume and actual Googlebook process eviction.
exitCriteria: No silent data loss, unbounded growth, stuck input, or surprise side-effect replay in supported cases.
Failures produce actionable bounded diagnostics.

stages.title: Protocol skew, data migrations, updates, and rollback
tasks: Test old/new app pairs, agent/backend skew, unknown optional capabilities, and incompatible major versions.
Exercise profile/journal/cache migrations transactionally, with recoverable backups and no secret export.
Build signed update/rollback candidates for the selected distribution channel and verify actual downgrade limits.
Record release manifest, schema/dependency hashes, SBOM, and provenance of artifacts.
deliverables: Signed candidate manifests and rollback procedure
exitCriteria: An upgrade failure preserves recoverable user state and explains required action.
Rollback is limited to verified supported paths, not an assumed Android downgrade.

stages.title: Distribution requirements and user documentation
tasks: Refresh current target-SDK/distribution requirements for the chosen channel; verify signing/license/source obligations.
Write setup, trust/key recovery, backend installation, permissions, input release, file conflicts, USB recovery, and diagnostics guides.
Publish only measured OS/compositor/probe/codec combinations and list explicit deferred capabilities.
Publish the desktop-only applicability ledger; keep phone/tablet optimization and phone continuity outside required release work.

Verify the actual Android distribution/device-catalog targeting and separate APK/AAB signing/install/update behavior; publish Googlebook desktop support only, with phone/tablet explicitly outside scope.
deliverables: Distribution checklist tied to actual candidate
exitCriteria: Users can complete the primary journeys and recover from known failures with the shipped documentation.
Phone continuity outside scope and VM roadmap features do not become accidental release blockers/promises.

stages.title: Ten-working-day dogfood and release decision
tasks: Use the candidate for at least ten working days across real Console, visual, files, and hardware workflows.
Track defects by severity, recurrence, topology/version, data impact, and recovery cost; reserve effort for fixes.
Re-run only affected gates after changes and recheck critical complete journeys before promotion.
Approve release with evidence/support matrix or retain candidate status with explicit unresolved defects.
Dogfood the complete revised desktop ecosystem workflows, collect applicable official desktop-quality evidence, and label every unsupported backend/device capability.
deliverables: Dogfood report with ten-day observation window
R5 release decision and known limitations
exitCriteria: No unresolved release-blocking data-loss/trust/replay/ownership/input defect.
At least ten working days observed; the 3–5 day estimate is active QA effort, not the observation duration.

targetScope: Googlebook desktop/laptop Android applications; no phone/tablet optimization workstream.
